metadata.description: FORSVN is a marketing/growth co-working stack for your coding agent — research, strategy, content & ads, and measurement skills that run the full growth loop. One front door (/forsvn) routes any request; every skill writes artifacts the next one reads, so context compounds. Engineering/build skills are the separate forsvn-dev package. From github.com/hungv47/meta-skills.

plugins.name: forsvn
plugins.description: Composable marketing/growth skills across research, strategy, content & ads, and measurement (meta/process included), plus a bundled review surface. /forsvn is the single front door — describe what you want in plain English and it routes you. Skills emit plain Markdown; /forsvn:review renders a themed preview and captures your approve / deny / request-changes decision. Engineering/build skills are the separate forsvn-dev package. Renamed from forsvn-skills; still distributed from hungv47/meta-skills for URL continuity.

plugins.name: forsvn-dev
plugins.description: Software-engineering skills extracted from the FORSVN growth stack — architecture, refactoring, dead-code cleanup, service extraction, in-product UX flow + UI specs, code/operator docs, engineering task breakdown, and native app builds. A separate companion to the forsvn growth product; install it only when you also want the build-side skills.
